name: walrus-sweep-inert-sampling-max-count-walrus
diagnosis:
Remove inert sampling_max_count from error-channel inputs

sampling_max_count on a memory (untyped) input channel does nothing:
sampling is implemented only in the file loaders, and these channels
read in-memory error channels. The intended cap on error records is
now provided by the operators themselves - jetrules and map_record
gained on_error/max_error_count (default 20) alongside ollama's.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

name: walrus-sort-key-in-expr-field-silently-dropped
diagnosis:
Fix the two sort operators sorting by nothing in map_eligibility_transaction

Both sort_config nodes carried the sort key in an "expr" key that SortSpec
does not have, so Go dropped it and the operators emitted records in
arrival order. The key moves to sort_by, where the engine reads it.
ValidatePipeSpecConfig now rejects a sort_config with neither domain_key
nor sort_by, so this shape cannot recur silently.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
